arguments.name: reaction
arguments.ownership: caller-owned writable12-byte output; special null-group rule for Ex

functions.return_contract: Borrowed completed sprite pointer; null while idle/hovering/pending

No native callback is invoked; VM wrapper dispatches callbacks using completed and hovered pointers.
Pending branch bypasses hit testing and cell reset.

build_differences.koikake: No global release-mode API; push/repeat node flags only. Sound suppression bit8 is ignored.
build_differences.reference: Release mode replaces node flags with2, losing flags4/8/0x10000. Push mode has no sound-suppression-bit8 checks.
build_differences.totsulover: Release mode ORs node flags with2; GetReaction respects sound-suppression bit8, including synthetic reaction using first node flags.
